State.description_en:
Session state. Valid values:

SessionStarting: Starting the session

SessionStartSuspended: Session start is suspended. Retry by calling Start again.

SessionStarted: Session started or in use

SessionStartFailed: Session failed to start

SessionAbnormal: Session became abnormal after starting successfully

SessionStopping: Stopping the session

SessionStopFailed: Session failed to stop
State.description_zh:
会话状态，取值范围，
SessionStarting：会话启动中
SessionStartSuspended：会话启动暂停，重新发起start可重试
SessionStarted：会话已启动/使用中
SessionStartFailed：会话启动失败
SessionAbnormal：会话启动成功后，出现状态异常
SessionStopping：会话停止中
SessionStopFailed：会话停止失败

UpdateTime.description_en: Time when the state was last updated
